AGENDA
  CIVIL SERVICE COMMISSION
  COUNCIL CHAMBERS
  613 E. Broadway, 2nd Floor
  Glendale, CA 91206
Meetings are broadcast live on Glendale TV, viewable on Spectrum Cable, channel 6, and AT&T U-
verse, channel 99. Meetings are also streamed live in high definition (HD) on the City webpage,
glendaleca.gov/live, on YouTube.com/myglendale, and on Apple TV, Roku, Amazon Fire, iOS and
Android devices using a free app called Cablecast and choosing "Glendale TV" from the menu.
Meetings are also archived on the City Website for viewing anytime at glendaleca.gov/agendas.
Call (818) 548-4013 for program schedules. For public comments and questions during the
meeting, call (818) 937-8100. Public comments on a specific agenda item will be taken when that
agenda item is discussed. If you have any question about matters on the agenda, or requests for
assistance, please contact the City Clerk at (818) 548-2090 during regular business hours.
  PLEASE TURN OFF CELLULAR PHONES WHILE INSIDE THE MEETING LOCATION
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) of 1990, auxiliary hearing aids, sign
language translation, and Braille transcripts are available upon request. Assisted listening devices
are available same-day upon request. The City Clerk’ office should be notified 72 hours (three
business days) or as soon as practicable for requests regarding sign language translation and
Braille transcription services. All documents related to open session items on this agenda that are
received less than 72 hours prior to this meeting, and are public records, will be available for review
in the Office of the City Clerk, 613 E. Broadway, RM 110, Glendale, CA 91206.
Translation services are provided for meetings through the use of bilingual staff for speakers who
wish to utilize the service as available. Speakers should state their request by contacting the City
Clerk’s office at (818) 548-2090, at least 72 hours prior to the scheduled meeting or as soon as
practicable. Please specify the language for which you require translation. The exclusive use of City
provided interpreters is not required and persons are welcome to use their own interpreter or speak
in their native language.
  SEPTEMBER 9, 2026 AT 5:00 PM

1.  ROLL CALL

2.  FLAG SALUTE

3.  MINUTES (Page 4)
  Action: Consideration for the minutes of the June 10, 2026 and July 8, 2026 meetings.

4.  ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
  Discussion is limited to items not part of the agenda. Each speaker is limited to three
  minutes. Commission may question or respond to the speaker but there will be no debate or
   decision.

5.  RECRUITMENT AND EXAMINATION REPORT (Page 9)
  No action required.

6.  ELIGIBLE LISTS ESTABLISHED (Page 11)
  No action required.

7.  JOB BULLETIN FOR APPROVAL - FIRE CAPTAIN (SNEARL) (Page 13)
  Action: Approve the job bulletin for Fire Captain as submitted.

8  JOB BULLETIN FOR APPROVAL - DIRECTOR OF COMMUNICATIONS AND COMMUNITY
  RELATIONS (SNEARL) (Page 20)
  Action: Approve the open job bulletin for Director of Communications and Community
  Relations as submitted.

9.  CLASS SPECIFICATION FOR APPROVAL - BILLING & COLLECTIONS TECHNICIAN
  (QUAN) (Page 25)
  Action: Approve the revised class specification for Billing & Collections Technician as
  submitted.

10.  CLASS SPECIFICATIONS FOR APPROVAL - ACCOUNTS PAYABLE TECHNICIAN I and
  ACCOUNTS PAYABLE TECHNICIAN II (QUAN) (Page 32)
  Action: Approve the revised class specifications for Accounts Payable Technician I and
  Accounts Payable Technician II as submitted.

11.  CLASS SPECIFICATION FOR APPROVAL - POLICE OFFICER RECRUIT (TAYLOR)
  (Page 42)
  Action: Approve the revised class specification for Police Officer Recruit as submitted.

12.  CLASS SPECIFICATION FOR APPROVAL - POLICE CUSTODY OFFICER (TAYLOR)
  (Page 51)
  Action: Approve the revised class specification for Police Custody Officer as submitted.

13.  CLASS SPECIFICATION FOR APPROVAL - POLICE CUSTODY OFFICER TRAINEE
  (TAYLOR) (Page 60)
  Action: Approve the class specification for Police Custody Officer Trainee as submitted.

14.  ADOPTION OF RESOLUTION - REPORT ON UNCLASSIFIED STATUS PROPOSAL FOR
  POLICE CUSTODY OFFICER TRAINEE (TAYLOR) (Page 69)
  Action: Adoption of resolution.

15.  CLASS SPECIFICATION FOR APPROVAL - HVAC MECHANIC (VARDANYAN) (Page 72)
  Action: Approve the revised class specification for HVAC Mechanic as submitted.

16.  CLASS SPECIFICATIONS FOR APPROVAL - FACILITIES MAINTENANCE SUPERVISOR
  AND SENIOR FACILITIES MAINTENANCE SUPERVISOR (VARDANYAN) (Page 79)
   Action: Approve the revised class specifications for Facilities Maintenance Supervisor and
  Senior Facilties Maintenance Supervisor as submitted.

17.  JOB BULLETIN FOR APPROVAL - SENIOR PUBLIC WORKS MANAGEMENT ANALYST
  (VARDANYAN) (Page 94)
  Action: Approve the open job bulletin for Senior Public Works Management Analyst as
  submitted.

18.  REPORTS - INFORMATION
  a. Employee Job Performance Evaluations Past Due Aging Report (Page 102)
  b. Temporary Assignment Extension Report (Page 103)

19.  PUBLIC EMPLOYEE DISCIPLINARY HEARING
  a) Assistant General Manager (Page 106)
  b) Senior Integrated Waste Truck Operator

20.  CIVIL SERVICE COMMISSION/STAFF COMMENTS

21.  ADJOURNMENT
  The Agenda for the September 9, 2026 Civil Service Commission meeting was posted on
  September 3, 2026 on the Bulletin Board Outside City Hall.
